# Lending (`LEND`)

Taking a copy off the shelf into a member's hands, and getting it back.

**Spec status:** partial

> **Deliberately unspecified.** These areas are known gaps, not oversights.
>
> - **Holds and reservations** — Queueing for a title that is fully out is wanted, but the branch-transfer rules it depends on are not settled. Tracked for a later proposal.
> - **Overdue fines and payment** — The library has not decided whether it charges fines at all; nothing here should assume it does.

## Requirements

### REQ-LEND-001

A librarian shall be able to check out an available copy to a member, and the system shall set the loan due 21 days from the day it is checked out.

**Risk:** high

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-LEND-001-1` | an available copy and a member in good standing | a librarian checks the copy out to them on 1 March | the copy is on loan to that member and the loan is due on 22 March |
| `AC-LEND-001-2` | a copy already on loan to another member | a librarian checks it out | the request is rejected with error COPY_ON_LOAN and the existing loan is unchanged |
| `AC-LEND-001-3` | a copy that has been removed from the catalogue | a librarian checks it out | the request is rejected with error COPY_NOT_FOUND |

### REQ-LEND-002

The system shall refuse to check out a copy to a member who already has ten copies on loan.

**Risk:** medium

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-LEND-002-1` | a member holding nine copies | a librarian checks out a tenth | the loan is created |
| `AC-LEND-002-2` | a member holding ten copies | a librarian checks out an eleventh | the request is rejected with error LOAN_LIMIT_REACHED |

### REQ-LEND-003

The system shall refuse to check out a copy to a member who has a loan that is overdue.

**Risk:** medium

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-LEND-003-1` | a member with one overdue loan | a librarian checks out another copy to them | the request is rejected with error MEMBER_HAS_OVERDUE_LOAN |
| `AC-LEND-003-2` | a member whose only overdue loan has just been returned | a librarian checks out a copy to them | the loan is created |

### REQ-LEND-004

A librarian shall be able to return a copy that is on loan, and the system shall close the loan and put the copy back on the shelf on the day it is returned.

**Risk:** high

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-LEND-004-1` | a copy on loan to a member | a librarian returns it on 10 March | the loan is closed with a return date of 10 March and the copy is available |
| `AC-LEND-004-2` | a copy that is already on the shelf | a librarian returns it | the request is rejected with error COPY_NOT_ON_LOAN |
| `AC-LEND-004-3` | a copy returned after its due date | a librarian returns it | the loan is closed and recorded as returned late |

### REQ-LEND-005

The system shall mark a loan overdue on the day after its due date, and shall keep it overdue until the copy is returned.

**Risk:** medium

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-LEND-005-1` | a loan due on 22 March that has not been returned | the day becomes 23 March | the loan is overdue |
| `AC-LEND-005-2` | a loan due on 22 March returned on 22 March | the day becomes 23 March | the loan is not overdue |

### REQ-LEND-006

A member shall be able to see their own current loans with the due date of each, and shall not be able to see another member's loans.

**Risk:** medium

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-LEND-006-1` | a member holding two copies | they ask for their loans | both loans are returned with their due dates |
| `AC-LEND-006-2` | a member | they ask for another member's loans | the request is rejected with error FORBIDDEN |
| `AC-LEND-006-3` | a librarian | they ask for a member's loans | the loans are returned |

### REQ-LEND-007

A librarian shall be able to get a report of all books currently lent out and to whom.

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-LEND-007-1` | a librarian | they ask for a complete report of lent books | the report of lent books to all users will be returned |
| `AC-LEND-007-2` | a non-librarian | they ask for a complete report of lent books | is refused with the result: FORBIDDEN |
